about: D12 (design/WARRANT.md, ruled 2026-10-29): one hero figure per page. This registry covers the Tier 1 pages of WARRANT.md's site pass (2026-10-28), keyed by their path under site/. Each row is exactly one of: "hero": true (the built page declares it, data-hero); "none": why the page has no hero; "pending": why it waits, allowed for an app only (the landing and apps/<name>/). `name` is the page as WARRANT.md's Tier 1 line names it. tools/check-wiring.js reads this file against that line and against the built pages: a Tier 1 page with no row, a row with no reason, a stale row, or a pending report refuses.
